description: CI timing baseline of the pre-monorepo repositories (step A3). Per workflow: the most recent SUCCESSFUL run on main (core publish-wasm: latest successful tag run). Job queue = started_at - created_at, run = completed_at - started_at; wall = first job created -> last job completed; sum_job_minutes = sum of job run times. Step buckets: setup (job set-up/teardown, checkout, toolchains, tool and dependency installs), cache (rust-cache / actions/cache restore + save), build_test (everything that builds or tests), artifact_report (uploads, downloads, publish, deploy, summaries). Read-only gh data.
